foundationText: That verse is our name and our foundation. Since 2024 we've been a small, growing family who worship together, open the Word together and carry one another through every season.
prayerIntro: Share as much or as little as you like. Our pastors read every request and pray over it this week.
weekNote: Every gathering is open to you.
heroIntro: A family built on Jesus, the chief cornerstone, where faith, community and love come together every week.
shepherdsNote: …and a team of worship leaders, youth shepherds and volunteers.
